issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation reverses the meaning of 'επιποθει' (desire/longing) and 'φθονον' (envy). The Greek says the Spirit 'desires envy' (or 'longs for envy'), while the Vietnamese says the Spirit 'loves to the point of envying' ('yêu thương đến nỗi ghen ghét'). Furthermore, the Vietnamese phrasing implies a positive intent (love) that is not present in the Greek structure.
The Vietnamese translation omits the phrase 'κενως' (in vain/uselessly), which modifies the first part of the Greek sentence.
